request.prompt:
Use the EXACT SAME BLUE CRYSTAL GOLEM as both supplied references, especially the model and eight views in reference2. Preserve pointed crystal head, pale blue eyes, massive faceted shoulders and long bulky fists, V chest, stout blue crystal legs/flat feet, sapphire/cobalt and icy-white facets. Same detailed painted2D RPG style and same proportions. No weapons, clothes, hair, tail, anatomy redesign or different ice robot. Head/torso/arms/hips/legs/feet stay physically joined by solid dark-blue joint bridges. Same isometric camera elevation, constant model size, no scene/background/labels/floor/shadow, alpha ZERO outside each whole body. No detached glow flecks, fog, shards, aura particles or loose body pieces. Blue rim/core light stays on the body. Every figure must be FULLY INSIDE its cell with generous transparent padding, never overlapping another. No cropped spikes/fists/toes, no copied/mirrored/scaled stills used as different poses. Real articulated joint movement and body weight, not texture jitter.
Exactly SIX figures in TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS. Left column faces S/front, right column faces SW/front-left. Each column is the SAME directional crystal golem doing a bare-fist MELEE attack. Row1 ANTICIPATION: rear support planted, hips/torso/right crystal shoulder wind back, right elbow/fist loaded, opposite arm balances. Row2 CONTACT: weight transfers to front planted foot; torso and the connected right shoulder/elbow/wrist drive a heavy right crystal fist FORWARD at the target in that direction. NO detached fist or weapon. Row3 RECOVERY: connected elbow bends, fist withdraws, hips/knees settle toward idle. A real whole-body attack, not a global lean. Keep every extended fist/head spike/toe fully inside a generous transparent cell. Only6 figures.
